SARNADISC MH: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sarnadisc MH, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sarnadisc-mh.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sarnadisc MH where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. Rectangular, zinc plated steel washer with rounded edges and specially shaped for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes. Fastened with one fastener per washer.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sarnadisc® MH washer is used for mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes by spot fastening in overlaps and / or intermediate spot fastening in combination with Sarnafast® fasteners. Only for fastening roof waterproofing membranes over hard substrates.Suitable roofing system under 70% R.H. environment without chemical corrosion condition.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sarnadisc MH
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: METAL WASHER FOR FIXING OF MEMBRANE TO ROOF STRUCTURES
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - EN ISO 9001 / 14001
    - DIN 50018 /GBT 9789-2008
    - ISO 9227 / GBT 10125-2012
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - DIN 50018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ISO 9227: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Lightweight
    - Resistant to most common environmental influences
    - Ease of application in use with recommended setting tools
    - Recyclable
2.5 Appearance and colour.
    | Surface | Smooth |
    | Color | Silver Grey |
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Weight: 6.6 kg/box
2.7 System structure. The following products must be considered for use depending on roof design: Sarnafast® Fastener 4.8 / 5.5 / 6.0 / 6.3
2.8 Corrosion resistance.
    | Property | Value | Standard |
    | Salt spray test | ≥ 1200 hours | GB/T 10125-2012 |
    | Kesternich test | ≥ 15 cycles | GB/T 9789-2008 |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: Product does not expire during correct storage.
2.10 Packaging. 300 pcs/box
    | Item code | Ø (mm) | T (mm) | T tube (mm) | W (mm) | B (mm) |
    | 482185 | 6.5 | 1 | 5 | 82 | 40 |
2.11 Storage conditions. The product must be stored in original, unopened an undamaged packaging in dry conditions between + 5 °C and + 30 °C. Always refer to packaging. Do not stack pallets or any other material on top during transportion or storage.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application. Sarnadisc® MH washer must be installed in accordance with Sika application manual and installation instructions. Sarnadisc® MH washer in combination with appropriate Sarnafast® Fastener is used for the mechanical fastening of roofing waterproofing membrane. For more information look up the Product Data Sheet Sarnafast® fastener.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Installation work must only be carried out by Sika® trained and approved contractors, experienced in this type of application
    - Special measures may be compulsory for installation below + 5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. - 20 °C min. / + 60 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. - 30 °C min. / + 60 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - Special measures may be compulsory for installation below + 5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sarnadisc MH, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sarnadisc-mh.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
